data.exact_reserve_text: During the year ended 31 December 2016 unfavourable actual versus expected experience was noted in the review carried out for the six months ended 30 June 2016, which led to the to the development pattern and prior loss assumptions being revised and additional IBNR being booked. For this year of account additional claims reserves, gross and net, have also been set aside for a large liability claim, arising from a serious sporting accident.

prior_year_events.impact_description: A large Australian liability claim was settled in the year ended 31 December 2016; two more events of significance remained under scrutiny - contributed to additional reserves and uncertainty on 2012 YOA.

prior_year_events.event_name: Large liability claim arising from a serious sporting accident
prior_year_events.impact_description: Additional claims reserves, gross and net, have been set aside for a large liability claim arising from a serious sporting accident impacting 2013 YOA.

data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves experienced volatility and overall adverse development in 2016. Reviews at mid-year identified unfavourable actual versus expected experience leading to revised development patterns and increased IBNR, and additional gross reserves were taken for significant large liability claims (including a large Australian liability settlement and a serious sporting accident). As a result, older years (notably 2012 and 2013) were retained in run-off to reduce uncertainty prior to any RITC.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (explicit). No explicit single-line gross "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" was located in the notes; narrative describes adverse development and additional IBNR but does not quantify a gross prior-year movement. A gross claims development triangle is present but OCR in source is noisy; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null rather than attempting an imprecise extraction. Gross premium mix by regulatory class was not found; a single 'Direct/reinsurance accepted' line has been provided (100%) based on the gross written premium total table.
